say:0:1122201001:0.text: We've been completing tons of bounties.
say:0:1122201001:0.source_cn: 主人最近完成的委托也不少了，不知道基地发展得怎么样？
say:0:1122201001:0.male: We've been completing tons of bounties.
say:0:1122201001:0.female: We've been completing tons of bounties.

say:1:1122201002:0.text: How's the base doing? Let's go check it out!
say:1:1122201002:0.source_cn: 满满提议，回基地看看情况！

say:2:1122202001:1.text: Chippy's here to do an inspection on the base's improvements!
say:2:1122202001:1.source_cn: 最近基地发展得怎么样？我们是来检查的！

say:3:1122202002:1.text: C'mon, what do you take me for? Of course it's improved tons! But you've actually timed your visit perfectly.
say:3:1122202002:1.source_cn: 有我在，用不着担心那么多。

say:4:1122202003:1.text: Remember that bounty from the Buckthorn Caravan? It's time to start digging into that and begin our second round of training!
say:4:1122202003:1.source_cn: 不过你们来得正好，还记得红沙棘商队的悬赏吧？是时候开始...

choice_prompt:5:1122202003.text: Remember that bounty from the Buckthorn Caravan? It's time to start digging into that and begin our second round of training!
choice_prompt:5:1122202003.source_cn: 不过你们来得正好，还记得红沙棘商队的悬赏吧？是时候开始调查，顺便进行第二次训练了。

say:6:1122202004:1.text: Of course! A bounty hunter's always gotta stay on their toes.
say:6:1122202004:1.source_cn: 当然！赏金猎人的差事可不是那么容易做的。

say:7:1122202007:1.text: Anyways, today's training is all about a crucial skill. Gathering intel!
say:7:1122202007:1.source_cn: 今天要训练的是一项必须掌握的技能——获取情报。

say:8:1122202008:1.text: Isn't that just when you go around and chat with people...?
say:8:1122202008:1.source_cn: 说得很厉害，实际上不就是到处和人聊天嘛……

say:9:1122202009:1.text: Hmph, don't underestimate just how tough this job can be.
say:9:1122202009:1.source_cn: 哼，你可别小瞧了这份工作的难度。

say:11:1122202010:1.text: Gathering intel is just the beginning. Figuring out what's true, piecing it all together, and finding informants is the real challenge!
say:11:1122202010:1.source_cn: 搜集情报只是最简单的一环，辨别真伪、汇总推断，还有拉拢...

say:12:1122202011:1.text: There are no shortcuts to mastering this skill, it just takes experience. Even after all these years I've been in the Eroded Enclave, building my own network hasn't been easy.
say:12:1122202011:1.source_cn: 想掌握这项技能，没有任何捷径，只能不断积攒经验。我在风...

say:13:1122202012:1.text: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
say:13:1122202012:1.source_cn: 眼下对你来说，那群偷走红沙棘商队货物的盗匪，就是最好的目标。
say:13:1122202012:1.male: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
say:13:1122202012:1.female: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.

choice_prompt:14:1122202012.text: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
choice_prompt:14:1122202012.source_cn: 眼下对你来说，那群偷走红沙棘商队货物的盗匪，就是最好的目标。
choice_prompt:14:1122202012.male: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.
choice_prompt:14:1122202012.female: And right now, those bandits that targeted the Buckthorn Caravan are our prime targets.

say:15:1122202014:1.text: Well, bandits who go after caravans are usually well-armed, so they're probably well-known by gun merchants.
say:15:1122202014:1.source_cn: 有能力劫掠商队的盗匪，必定火力强悍，免不了要和枪械商人...

say:16:1122202015:1.text: And as far as I know, there's only one person in the entire Eroded Enclave who deals with guns—<style="highlight">Cyril</style> in Alkali.
say:16:1122202015:1.source_cn: 据我所知，整个风蚀飞地，做这门生意的只有一个人——咸水...

say:17:1122202016:1.text: Cyril's a true merchant. If the price is right, he'll sell anything. But first, you've gotta build trust with him.
say:17:1122202016:1.source_cn: 西里尔是个不折不扣的商人。只要钱到位，他什么都能卖，不...

choice_prompt:18:1122202016.text: Cyril's a true merchant. If the price is right, he'll sell anything. But first, you've gotta build trust with him.
choice_prompt:18:1122202016.source_cn: 西里尔是个不折不扣的商人。只要钱到位，他什么都能卖，不过前提是——得建立一定的信任关系。

say:19:1122202018:1.text: He monopolizes the gun trade. If we can get him on our side, he'll surely have lots to offer!
say:19:1122202018:1.source_cn: 垄断了枪械生意的商人，要是能和我们合作，肯定能提供不少...

say:20:1122202019:1.text: Apart from Cyril, there have also been some new faces at the <style="highlight">horse ranch to the east</style> and a merchant at the <style="highlight">inn on the outskirts</style> who's been bellyaching about getting ripped off by bandits. They might have something worth hearing.

say:21:1122202020:1.text: It'd be great if we could find intel on the <style="highlight">bandit's camp</style> or <style="highlight">missing goods</style> from the Buckthorn Caravan.
say:21:1122202020:1.source_cn: 要是能打探到<style=highlight>盗匪营地...

say:22:1122202021:1.text: I'll have Wildclaw and Grayhorn double-check the information. Here's hoping neither of you lets me down.
say:22:1122202021:1.source_cn: 我会给烈爪和老憨安排同样的任务，这样可以验证情报的准确...

choice:18:0:1.text: You want him as an informant?
choice:18:0:1.male: You want him as an informant?
choice:18:0:1.female: You want him as an informant?

say:24:1122202017:1.text: If you turn him into our informant, I'll foot the bill of course!
say:24:1122202017:1.source_cn: ……你把他变成我们的线人，我自然会付账！
say:24:1122202017:1.male: If you turn him into our informant, I'll foot the bill of course!
say:24:1122202017:1.female: If you turn him into our informant, I'll foot the bill of course!

choice:18:1:2.text: But how will we entice him?
choice:18:1:2.male: But how will we entice him?
choice:18:1:2.female: But how will we entice him?

choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 你知道该上哪打听情报？

say:25:1122202013:1.text: You think I haven't already tried asking them for info? When they were robbed, those merchants were all over the place. Not one of them had any useful info.
say:25:1122202013:1.source_cn: 你以为我没去问过？\n被抢劫的时候，那帮商人都乱成一团...
say:25:1122202013:1.male: You think I haven't already tried asking them for info? When they were robbed, those merchants were all over the place. Not one of them had any useful info.
say:25:1122202013:1.female: You think I haven't already tried asking them for info? When they were robbed, those merchants were all over the place. Not one of them had any useful info.

choice:14:1:2.text: Why not ask the Buckthorn Caravan?
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 为什么不去问问红沙棘商队呢？
choice:14:1:2.male: Why not ask the Buckthorn Caravan?
choice:14:1:2.female: Why not ask the Buckthorn Caravan?

say:26:1122202005:1.text: Ever heard the saying, "Once a member, always a member"?
say:26:1122202005:1.source_cn: 呵，有一句话你听过没？“既然上了贼船，就别想跑了”！
say:26:1122202005:1.male: Ever heard the saying, "Once a member, always a member"?
say:26:1122202005:1.female: Ever heard the saying, "Once a member, always a member"?

say:27:1122202006:1.text: Don't tell me you decided to try out bounty hunting as a hobby?! You gotta take this seriously!
say:27:1122202006:1.source_cn: 这话放在我们身上也很合适——只不过我们是“抓贼的船”。

say:0:1122203001:0.text: Silverbeak mentioned three spots. Chippy remembers them all!
say:0:1122203001:0.source_cn: 银喙说的三个地方是咸水镇上的枪械店、马场，还有镇郊旅店...

say:1:1122203002:0.text: Off we go! Let's find some solid intel!
say:1:1122203002:0.source_cn: 现在就出发吧！希望能找到可靠的情报！

say:3:1122204001:1.text: What are you in the market for? A hunting rifle, bullets, or maybe some explosives?
say:3:1122204001:1.source_cn: 您准备买点什么？猎枪、子弹，还是炸药？
say:3:1122204001:1.male: What are you in the market for? A hunting rifle, bullets, or maybe some explosives?
say:3:1122204001:1.female: What are you in the market for? A hunting rifle, bullets, or maybe some explosives?

say:4:1122204002:1.text: We're here to find secrets—mhff, stop covering Chippy's mouth!
say:4:1122204002:1.source_cn: 老板，我们是来买情——唔唔唔，漫漫！你干嘛捂我的嘴！？

say:5:1122204003:1.text: Stupid Chippy, don't go blurting stuff like that!
say:5:1122204003:1.source_cn: 笨满满，这种时候就不要乱说话了！

choice_prompt:6:1122204003.text: Stupid Chippy, don't go blurting stuff like that!
choice_prompt:6:1122204003.source_cn: 笨满满，这种时候就不要乱说话了！

say:7:1122204004:1.text: Darn, I thought I was gonna get a big sale today! But turns out you're just after some information.
say:7:1122204004:1.source_cn: 哎呀哎呀，我还以为来了桩大买卖，没想到只是想打听消息啊。

say:8:1122204006:1.text: Who do you want info on? Give me a name, and I'll name a price.
say:8:1122204006:1.source_cn: 您想问谁，可以直说，也方便我给您报个价。
say:8:1122204006:1.male: Who do you want info on? Give me a name, and I'll name a price.
say:8:1122204006:1.female: Who do you want info on? Give me a name, and I'll name a price.

say:11:1122204008:1.text: You want info on that? Just letting you know, that won't come cheap. It'll cost... this much!
say:11:1122204008:1.source_cn: 当然。不过这伙人的消息，价格可不低。至少得要……这个数！

say:12:1122204009:1.text: T-three thousand gold?! That's so much!

say:13:1122204010:1.text: Hey, good intel is priceless! And looking at you, handling all those big bounties, you should be swimming in cash.
say:13:1122204010:1.source_cn: 话不能这样说。像您这种有能力接手巨额悬赏的客人，出手一...
say:13:1122204010:1.male: Hey, good intel is priceless! And looking at you, handling all those big bounties, you should be swimming in cash.
say:13:1122204010:1.female: Hey, good intel is priceless! And looking at you, handling all those big bounties, you should be swimming in cash.

say:14:1122204011:1.text: And if that's too much for you all at once, I'm willing to let you pay in installments. And I only charge 40% interest! That's super fair, right?
say:14:1122204011:1.source_cn: 而且，我也可以接受分期付款，只收四成利息。财物抵押或是...

choice_prompt:15:1122204011.text: And if that's too much for you all at once, I'm willing to let you pay in installments. And I only charge 40% interest! That's super fair, right?
choice_prompt:15:1122204011.source_cn: 而且，我也可以接受分期付款，只收四成利息。财物抵押或是少量赊账也没问题。

say:16:1122204012:1.text: You mean... you want me as your regular informant?
say:16:1122204012:1.source_cn: 您指的是……收买我当您的线人？
say:16:1122204012:1.male: You mean... you want me as your regular informant?
say:16:1122204012:1.female: You mean... you want me as your regular informant?

say:17:1122204013:1.text: Hmm. I don't know who's backing you, but this offer is quite tempting! You're the first person I've met in this town to play it so straight!
say:17:1122204013:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道您背后是哪方势力，但这个提议……着实令人心动...
say:17:1122204013:1.male: Hmm. I don't know who's backing you, but this offer is quite tempting! You're the first person I've met in this town to play it so straight!
say:17:1122204013:1.female: Hmm. I don't know who's backing you, but this offer is quite tempting! You're the first person I've met in this town to play it so straight!

say:18:1122204014:1.text: In that case, I won't waste any more of your time. Lemme tell ya, I've dealt with them before but I have no idea where their camp is located.
say:18:1122204014:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我也不啰嗦。那帮盗匪的确在我这买过不少好东西...

say:19:1122204015:1.text: Though judging by their moves, they're likely by the <style="highlight">southeast of town</style>.
say:19:1122204015:1.source_cn: 不过看他们出现的方向，大概率在<style=highl...

say:20:1122204016:1.text: By the way, they got a few guys <style="highlight">posing as merchants</style> at the <style="highlight">horse ranch to the east</style>. Those guys are in charge of recruiting.

say:21:1122204017:1.text: You could head over and feel them out if you're feeling brave. But don't blow your cover! I need you alive to return with my reward!
say:21:1122204017:1.source_cn: 要是胆子够大，您可以直接去探探他们的口风。只是得多加小...
say:21:1122204017:1.male: You could head over and feel them out if you're feeling brave. But don't blow your cover! I need you alive to return with my reward!
say:21:1122204017:1.female: You could head over and feel them out if you're feeling brave. But don't blow your cover! I need you alive to return with my reward!

choice:15:0:1.text: Let's think a bit more long-term.
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 我们可以长期合作，定期结款
choice:15:0:1.male: Let's think a bit more long-term.
choice:15:0:1.female: Let's think a bit more long-term.

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 偷走红沙棘货物的盗匪，你认识吧？

choice:6:0:1.text: I'm looking for a certain group.
choice:6:0:1.male: I'm looking for a certain group.
choice:6:0:1.female: I'm looking for a certain group.

say:23:1122204005:1.text: Ah, got it! You're looking for some information, right? No problem!
say:23:1122204005:1.source_cn: 噢——我知道了，您想买情报对吧？好说，好说！
say:23:1122204005:1.male: Ah, got it! You're looking for some information, right? No problem!
say:23:1122204005:1.female: Ah, got it! You're looking for some information, right? No problem!

choice:6:1:2.text: I'm not looking for physical items.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我们不是来买枪和火药的
choice:6:1:2.male: I'm not looking for physical items.
choice:6:1:2.female: I'm not looking for physical items.

say:0:1122205001:0.text: Magister, do you think we can really trust what he said?
say:0:1122205001:0.source_cn: 主人，西里尔说的话真的可信吗？
say:0:1122205001:0.male: Magister, do you think we can really trust what he said?
say:0:1122205001:0.female: Magister, do you think we can really trust what he said?

say:1:1122205002:0.text: It does seem a bit suspicious how quickly he agreed...
say:1:1122205002:0.source_cn: 我也觉得很反常，他同意得太快了……

say:2:1122205003:0.text: Whatever the case, let's check out the "merchants" at the ranch first.
say:2:1122205003:0.source_cn: 他不是说马场里的商人也是盗匪的同伙吗，我们去打探一下，...
say:2:1122205003:0.male: Whatever the case, let's check out the "merchants" at the ranch first.
say:2:1122205003:0.female: Whatever the case, let's check out the "merchants" at the ranch first.

say:2:1122206001:1.text: Whatever you want, you've got the wrong guy.
say:2:1122206001:1.source_cn: 我不认识你，你找错人了。
say:2:1122206001:1.male: Whatever you want, you've got the wrong guy.
say:2:1122206001:1.female: Whatever you want, you've got the wrong guy.

say:3:1122206002:1.text: Good sir, we're just walking around! We're interested in talking to people nearby about this town.
say:3:1122206002:1.source_cn: 这位大叔，你别生气，最近镇上不太平，我们只是想来打听一些事。

say:4:1122206003:1.text: You wanna talk to me? Well, I'm new to Alkali so I don't know bull!
say:4:1122206003:1.source_cn: 和我打听？我刚来咸水镇没多久，什么都不知道！

say:8:1122206005:1.text: What odd behavior, I bet he's hiding something!
say:8:1122206005:1.source_cn: 他表现得好反常，肯定隐瞒着什么事。

say:9:1122206006:1.text: Guess Cyril was telling the truth. Magister, we can't let down our guards and blow our cover!
say:9:1122206006:1.source_cn: 看来枪械店老板说的是真的。主人，接下来我们得更加小心，...
say:9:1122206006:1.male: Guess Cyril was telling the truth. Magister, we can't let down our guards and blow our cover!
say:9:1122206006:1.female: Guess Cyril was telling the truth. Magister, we can't let down our guards and blow our cover!

say:12:1122206007:1.text: Are you done whispering? Go on, shoo!
say:12:1122206007:1.source_cn: 喂，你们聊完了没有？别挡着我吹风了！

choice_prompt:13:1122206007.text: Are you done whispering? Go on, shoo!
choice_prompt:13:1122206007.source_cn: 喂，你们聊完了没有？别挡着我吹风了！

choice:13:1:2.text: You hear about any bandits lately?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 你认识最近出没的那伙盗匪吧
choice:13:1:2.male: You hear about any bandits lately?
choice:13:1:2.female: You hear about any bandits lately?

say:2:1122207001:1.text: The ones with bounties plastered all over town? Hah, everyone knows them.
say:2:1122207001:1.source_cn: 你说的是到处贴悬赏令的那个商队？哈，咸水镇上恐怕没人不知道。
say:2:1122207001:1.male: The ones with bounties plastered all over town? Hah, everyone knows them.
say:2:1122207001:1.female: The ones with bounties plastered all over town? Hah, everyone knows them.

say:3:1122207002:1.text: So, you a bounty hunter? You're looking for intel on them too?
say:3:1122207002:1.source_cn: 怎么，你也接了委托，现在在打探情报？
say:3:1122207002:1.male: So, you a bounty hunter? You're looking for intel on them too?
say:3:1122207002:1.female: So, you a bounty hunter? You're looking for intel on them too?

choice_prompt:4:1122207002.text: So, you a bounty hunter? You're looking for intel on them too?
choice_prompt:4:1122207002.source_cn: 怎么，你也接了委托，现在在打探情报？
choice_prompt:4:1122207002.male: So, you a bounty hunter? You're looking for intel on them too?
choice_prompt:4:1122207002.female: So, you a bounty hunter? You're looking for intel on them too?

say:5:1122207005:1.text: You're in luck, kiddo. You found me, the only witness to that whole situation!
say:5:1122207005:1.male: You're in luck, kiddo. You found me, the only witness to that whole situation!
say:5:1122207005:1.female: You're in luck, kiddo. You found me, the only witness to that whole situation!

say:7:1122207007:1.text: That's right! I was nearby hauling goods and caught sight of the bandits heading towards... where was it... Oh right! North of the <style="highlight">Crimson Highlands</style>!
say:7:1122207007:1.source_cn: 没错。红沙棘商队被劫的时候，我正在附近运货，刚好看到那...

say:11:1122207009:1.text: I... ran into a sandstorm! You know how it is up there. When those storms show up, you're blind as a bat!
say:11:1122207009:1.source_cn: 我……我刚好碰上了沙暴！你们也知道，高原上的沙暴一刮起...

say:14:1122207010:1.text: Then how did he manage to see those bandits...?
say:14:1122207010:1.source_cn: 既然如此，你又是怎么看清那些盗匪的呢……
say:14:1122207010:1.male: Then how did he manage to see those bandits...?
say:14:1122207010:1.female: Then how did he manage to see those bandits...?

say:17:1122207013:1.text: We'll go follow the lead you gave us, thank you! Bye bye!
say:17:1122207013:1.source_cn: 我们……我们要去其他地方再打听看看！谢谢你的情报！
say:17:1122207013:1.male: We'll go follow the lead you gave us, thank you! Bye bye!
say:17:1122207013:1.female: We'll go follow the lead you gave us, thank you! Bye bye!

say:20:1122207004:1.text: You're totally pulling my leg! Heh, that trick won't work on me.
say:20:1122207004:1.source_cn: ……不，不对。你在和我开玩笑。\n呵，这点小伎俩可骗不了我。
say:20:1122207004:1.male: You're totally pulling my leg! Heh, that trick won't work on me.
say:20:1122207004:1.female: You're totally pulling my leg! Heh, that trick won't work on me.

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我说我是盗匪的人，你信吗

say:0:1122208001:0.text: That guy's info doesn't match what Cyril told us at all.
say:0:1122208001:0.source_cn: 这个人说的盗匪逃跑的方向，和西里尔大叔告诉我们的完全不一样。

say:1:1122208002:0.text: And his story was all over the place.
say:1:1122208002:0.source_cn: 而且，他说话不仅结结巴巴的，还前后矛盾。

say:2:1122208003:0.text: Chippy thinks that guy was a total scammer! Let's follow Cyril's word!
say:2:1122208003:0.source_cn: 他肯定是在骗人！满满觉得，还是西里尔更可靠！

say:3:1122208004:0.text: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
say:3:1122208004:0.source_cn: 别着急，我们再去和镇郊旅店的商人聊聊。
say:3:1122208004:0.male: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
say:3:1122208004:0.female: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.

say:2:1122209001:1.text: Huh? What are you implying? What do you know?!
say:2:1122209001:1.source_cn: ……哈？你这话是什么意思？你都知道些什么？！
say:2:1122209001:1.male: Huh? What are you implying? What do you know?!
say:2:1122209001:1.female: Huh? What are you implying? What do you know?!

say:3:1122209002:1.text: I'm telling you, you won't get a word outta me!
say:3:1122209002:1.source_cn: 我告诉你，别想从我嘴里问出关于他们的事！门也没有！
say:3:1122209002:1.male: I'm telling you, you won't get a word outta me!
say:3:1122209002:1.female: I'm telling you, you won't get a word outta me!

say:4:1122209003:1.text: He suddenly got so worked up! Did we blow our cover?!
say:4:1122209003:1.source_cn: 他……他突然变得好激动！我们是不是露馅了？！

say:5:1122209004:1.text: Hmph. I didn't want to resort to this, but since you're sniffing around so much, don't blame me for getting rough!
say:5:1122209004:1.source_cn: 哼，我本来不想惹麻烦的。但既然你们都知道了，就别怪我下...

say:0:1122211001:0.text: Wow! <style="stress"><player_name></style> barely spoke a word, and this guy spilled all the beans already.
say:0:1122211001:0.male: Wow! <style="stress"><player_name></style> barely spoke a word, and this guy spilled all the beans already.
say:0:1122211001:0.female: Wow! <style="stress"><player_name></style> barely spoke a word, and this guy spilled all the beans already.

say:1:1122211002:0.text: Seems like Cyril's intel was spot on.
say:1:1122211002:0.source_cn: 看来，西里尔大叔告诉我们的情报是真的。

say:2:1122211003:0.text: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
say:2:1122211003:0.source_cn: 别着急，我们再去和镇郊旅店的商人聊聊。
say:2:1122211003:0.male: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.
say:2:1122211003:0.female: Let's go talk to the merchant at that inn on the outskirts next.

say:3:1122212001:1.text: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
say:3:1122212001:1.source_cn: 有什么事吗？如果你是来请我一杯的，我没意见。
say:3:1122212001:1.male: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
say:3:1122212001:1.female: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?

choice_prompt:4:1122212001.text: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
choice_prompt:4:1122212001.source_cn: 有什么事吗？如果你是来请我一杯的，我没意见。
choice_prompt:4:1122212001.male: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?
choice_prompt:4:1122212001.female: Need something? Or are you just looking to buy a drink for a pretty girl like me?

say:5:1122212002:1.text: Darn, am I famous now because of that? Ah, how embarrassing...
say:5:1122212002:1.source_cn: ……我已经因为这事出名了吗？\n唉，还真是丢人啊……

say:6:1122212003:1.text: They cleaned me out. I can't offer a bounty to get my stuff back even if I wanted to. Sorry if you were here for that.
say:6:1122212003:1.source_cn: 我身上的金币都被骗光了，没钱悬赏，你请回吧。
say:6:1122212003:1.male: They cleaned me out. I can't offer a bounty to get my stuff back even if I wanted to. Sorry if you were here for that.
say:6:1122212003:1.female: They cleaned me out. I can't offer a bounty to get my stuff back even if I wanted to. Sorry if you were here for that.

say:7:1122212004:1.text: W-wait, we're here to help! And we don't expect compensation!
say:7:1122212004:1.source_cn: 等等，我们不是来帮你——不对，我们不是来接委托的！

say:8:1122212005:1.text: Those bandits who cheated you are probably the same ones who robbed the Buckthorn Caravan, and we're here to get your story.
say:8:1122212005:1.source_cn: 骗你钱的那群盗匪，应该就是劫走红沙棘商队货物的人！我们...

say:9:1122212008:1.text: What?! I can't believe they even robbed a caravan. That's outrageous!
say:9:1122212008:1.source_cn: 什么？！这群混蛋都敢直接抢劫？！简直无法无天了！

say:10:1122212009:1.text: Alright, what do you want to know? I'll tell you everything.
say:10:1122212009:1.source_cn: 说吧，你们有什么想了解的，我一定知无不言。

choice_prompt:11:1122212009.text: Alright, what do you want to know? I'll tell you everything.
choice_prompt:11:1122212009.source_cn: 说吧，你们有什么想了解的，我一定知无不言。

say:12:1122212010:1.text: I sold them some goods, and they didn't pay up. They reneged on our deal!
say:12:1122212010:1.source_cn: 很简单。先交货，再拿钱——我遵守了规矩，他们却赖账了。

say:13:1122212011:1.text: What did you sell to them?

say:14:1122212012:1.text: Some simple weapons, like daggers, arrows, smoke bombs.
say:14:1122212012:1.source_cn: 一些可以随身携带的武器，匕首、袖箭、烟雾弹之类的。

say:15:1122212013:1.text: Hm? Those weapons are more for self-defense. Do bandits really need those?
say:15:1122212013:1.source_cn: 哎？这些东西更像是防身用的，盗匪真的用得到吗？

say:16:1122212014:1.text: No idea, but the guy I traded with didn't seem like a bandit. If his underlings hadn't said what they said, I wouldn't have even guessed they were bad guys.
say:16:1122212014:1.source_cn: 这我就不知道了，不过他们派来和我交易的那家伙的确不怎么...

choice_prompt:17:1122212014.text: No idea, but the guy I traded with didn't seem like a bandit. If his underlings hadn't said what they said, I wouldn't have even guessed they were bad guys.
choice_prompt:17:1122212014.source_cn: 这我就不知道了，不过他们派来和我交易的那家伙的确不怎么像盗匪。要不是他手下说漏了嘴，我也不知道他们的身份。

say:18:1122212015:1.text: I remember them blaming the Quicksand Claws for some theft and saying something about "the most dangerous place is also the safest."
say:18:1122212015:1.source_cn: 我记得说的是“把抢东西的事推给流沙之爪”，还有什么……...

say:19:1122212016:1.text: Though I'm not sure what that last part means. Perhaps they were talking about their camp's location?
say:19:1122212016:1.source_cn: 不过，后面这一句具体指的是什么，我就不清楚了。可能是他...

say:20:1122212017:1.text: "The most dangerous place"... Maybe they mean the Quicksand Claw camp?
say:20:1122212017:1.source_cn: 最危险的地方……难道是指流沙之爪的营地？

say:21:1122212018:1.text: Come to think of it, the <style="highlight">Quicksand Claw camp</style> is to the southeast of Alkali. It matches Cyril's intel! Could the bandits be hiding nearby?

say:22:1122212019:1.text: Either way, thanks for the info, miss!
say:22:1122212019:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，谢谢你提供的情报，被骗的商人小姐！

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你就是那个被盗匪骗了的商人吧

say:24:1122212006:1.text: Huh... but I really can't repay you. Are you sure you're okay with that?
say:24:1122212006:1.source_cn: 呃……你说的是骗我货物的那群盗匪？但我没发悬赏啊。

say:25:1122212007:1.text: Don't worry! They also swindled the Buckthorn Caravan, so we'll be paid by that bounty!
say:25:1122212007:1.source_cn: 他们劫走了红沙棘商队的货物，商队正在悬赏他们呢！

choice:4:1:2.text: I'd like to hear what happened.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我想打听一下那群盗匪的事
choice:4:1:2.male: I'd like to hear what happened.
choice:4:1:2.female: I'd like to hear what happened.

say:0:1122213001:0.text: We've checked all three places. We can confirm that the bandits' camp is southeast of Alkali.
say:0:1122213001:0.source_cn: 三个地方都打听过一遍了，目前可以确定的是盗匪营地在咸水...
say:0:1122213001:0.male: We've checked all three places. We can confirm that the bandits' camp is southeast of Alkali.
say:0:1122213001:0.female: We've checked all three places. We can confirm that the bandits' camp is southeast of Alkali.

say:1:1122213002:0.text: Let's head back and tell Silverbeak about our findings.
say:1:1122213002:0.source_cn: 回基地把这个情报告诉银喙吧。
say:1:1122213002:0.male: Let's head back and tell Silverbeak about our findings.
say:1:1122213002:0.female: Let's head back and tell Silverbeak about our findings.

say:2:1122214001:1.text: How'd everything go? Don't tell me you somehow messed up and now need my help.
say:2:1122214001:1.source_cn: 消息打听得怎么样？别是搞砸了来请我帮忙的吧。

say:3:1122214002:1.text: No way! The magister was amazing as always, something as simple as gathering intel wouldn't get him down!
say:3:1122214002:1.source_cn: 怎么可能！主人亲自出马，收集情报这种小事当然不在话下！
say:3:1122214002:1.male: No way! The magister was amazing as always, something as simple as gathering intel wouldn't get him down!
say:3:1122214002:1.female: No way! The magister was amazing as always, something as simple as gathering intel wouldn't get her down!

choice_prompt:4:1122214002.text: No way! The magister was amazing as always, something as simple as gathering intel wouldn't get him down!
choice_prompt:4:1122214002.source_cn: 怎么可能！主人亲自出马，收集情报这种小事当然不在话下！
choice_prompt:4:1122214002.male: No way! The magister was amazing as always, something as simple as gathering intel wouldn't get him down!
choice_prompt:4:1122214002.female: No way! The magister was amazing as always, something as simple as gathering intel wouldn't get her down!

say:5:1122214003:1.text: Southeast of Alkali, near the Quicksand Claw camp? Well done, that's even more detailed than I expected.
say:5:1122214003:1.source_cn: 咸水镇的东南方，可能靠近流沙之爪的主营……不错嘛，比我...

say:6:1122214004:1.text: And you even got Cyril on board as our informant. I never knew that guy could be so cooperative. I guess money talks!
say:6:1122214004:1.source_cn: 而且你还拉拢了西里尔当线人……这个老家伙，以前真没看出...
say:6:1122214004:1.male: And you even got Cyril on board as our informant. I never knew that guy could be so cooperative. I guess money talks!
say:6:1122214004:1.female: And you even got Cyril on board as our informant. I never knew that guy could be so cooperative. I guess money talks!

say:7:1122214005:1.text: Getting the same info from two different sources confirms its accuracy. I gotta admit you're getting good at this.
say:7:1122214005:1.source_cn: 这次你能从两个人口中得到相同的情报，也算是变相验证了情...
say:7:1122214005:1.male: Getting the same info from two different sources confirms its accuracy. I gotta admit you're getting good at this.
say:7:1122214005:1.female: Getting the same info from two different sources confirms its accuracy. I gotta admit you're getting good at this.

say:8:1122214006:1.text: By the way, have you guys seen Wildclaw and Grayhorn? They left a little bit after you guys did.
say:8:1122214006:1.source_cn: 说起来，烈爪和老憨怎么还没回来？他们没比你晚出发多少。
say:8:1122214006:1.male: By the way, have you guys seen Wildclaw and Grayhorn? They left a little bit after you guys did.
say:8:1122214006:1.female: By the way, have you guys seen Wildclaw and Grayhorn? They left a little bit after you guys did.

say:9:1122214007:1.text: Hang on... Wildclaw's so responsible, there's no way he wouldn't be back by now!
say:9:1122214007:1.source_cn: 不对……！就烈爪那个急性子，不可能到现在还不回来！

choice_prompt:10:1122214007.text: Hang on... Wildclaw's so responsible, there's no way he wouldn't be back by now!
choice_prompt:10:1122214007.source_cn: 不对……！就烈爪那个急性子，不可能到现在还不回来！

say:12:1122214010:1.text: According to you, the merchant at the stable was an accomplice of the bandits. Oh no... I bet Wildclaw and Grayhorn blew their cover.
say:12:1122214010:1.source_cn: 按你的说法，马场里的假商人是盗匪的同伙，烈爪和老憨那两...
say:12:1122214010:1.male: According to you, the merchant at the stable was an accomplice of the bandits. Oh no... I bet Wildclaw and Grayhorn blew their cover.
say:12:1122214010:1.female: According to you, the merchant at the stable was an accomplice of the bandits. Oh no... I bet Wildclaw and Grayhorn blew their cover.

say:13:1122214011:1.text: Go check on them and see if they're okay!
say:13:1122214011:1.source_cn: 你赶快过去看看，别让他们出事！
say:13:1122214011:1.male: Go check on them and see if they're okay!
say:13:1122214011:1.female: Go check on them and see if they're okay!

say:15:1122214009:1.text: I'd believe that of Grayhorn, but Wildclaw's always been good with things like this.
say:15:1122214009:1.source_cn: 要是只有老憨，的确有这种可能。但这次烈爪跟着他呢！

choice:4:0:1.text: So here's what we found out...
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: （将盗匪营地的情报告诉银喙）
choice:4:0:1.male: So here's what we found out...
choice:4:0:1.female: So here's what we found out...

say:0:1122215001:0.text: Spit it out! What did you overhear?!
say:0:1122215001:0.source_cn: 说！你们都打听出了什么！

say:1:1122215002:0.text: Hmph! We will never talk, even if you break our legs!
say:1:1122215002:0.source_cn: ——呸！就算你打断我们的腿，我们也绝对不会说的！

say:2:1122215003:0.text: You cocky little... You're gonna regret being that stubborn. I'll teach you a lesson!
say:2:1122215003:0.source_cn: 打听了不该打听的事，还嘴犟？！看我怎么收拾你！

say:3:1122215004:0.text: Oh no, they've been caught! Let's go save them!
say:3:1122215004:0.source_cn: 不好，烈爪和老憨真的被抓住了！我们得赶紧阻止这些坏家伙！

say:1:1122216002:0.text: They seem pretty banged up. Let's check how they're doing.
say:1:1122216002:0.source_cn: 烈爪和老憨好像伤得不轻，我们快去看看他们的情况吧。

say:2:1122217001:1.text: Thanks for coming to get us. I really thought we were done for...
say:2:1122217001:1.source_cn: 多谢来救我们。我差点以为今天自己就要交代在这了。
say:2:1122217001:1.male: Thanks for coming to get us. I really thought we were done for...
say:2:1122217001:1.female: Thanks for coming to get us. I really thought we were done for...

choice_prompt:3:1122217001.text: Thanks for coming to get us. I really thought we were done for...
choice_prompt:3:1122217001.source_cn: 多谢来救我们。我差点以为今天自己就要交代在这了。
choice_prompt:3:1122217001.male: Thanks for coming to get us. I really thought we were done for...
choice_prompt:3:1122217001.female: Thanks for coming to get us. I really thought we were done for...

say:4:1122217003:1.text: Anyone gonna notice me...? I feel like I'm hurting all over...
say:4:1122217003:1.source_cn: 有没有人理我一下……我感觉浑身上下都在疼……

say:5:1122217004:1.text: Is it that serious? I guess I should take Grayhorn back to base first.
say:5:1122217004:1.source_cn: 这么严重？\n……我看我还是先带老憨回基地吧。

say:8:1122217002:1.text: After saving my life, all you want is money? Deal!
say:8:1122217002:1.source_cn: 这么大个人情，只用付钱就行？那我真是赚大了。

say:2:1122218001:1.text: Silverbeak, how are they doing? Grayhorn's wounds looked really really bad! Chippy was so worried!
say:2:1122218001:1.source_cn: 银喙，烈爪和老憨的伤势还好吗？在马场的时候老憨一直喊疼...

say:3:1122218002:1.text: They'll be fine. A few days' rest and they'll be back to their normal cheerful selves.
say:3:1122218002:1.source_cn: 不碍大事，休息几天就能活蹦乱跳的了。

say:4:1122218003:1.text: But the intel they brought back... I could instantly tell it was bogus. You did a way better job, newbie!
say:4:1122218003:1.source_cn: 不过他们带回来的情报……光凭经验判断，我都能知道是假的...
say:4:1122218003:1.male: But the intel they brought back... I could instantly tell it was bogus. You did a way better job, newbie!
say:4:1122218003:1.female: But the intel they brought back... I could instantly tell it was bogus. You did a way better job, newbie!

say:5:1122218004:1.text: Once they're both better, I'll give them a proper lesson on gathering intel so they don't embarrass us again.
say:5:1122218004:1.source_cn: 等他们伤好，我该给他们也好好上一门情报课，免得出去丢人现眼。

say:6:1122218005:1.text: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
say:6:1122218005:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，你算是成功掌握了获取情报的技能，记得要多加训练。
say:6:1122218005:1.male: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
say:6:1122218005:1.female: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.

choice_prompt:7:1122218005.text: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
choice_prompt:7:1122218005.source_cn: 不管怎么样，你算是成功掌握了获取情报的技能，记得要多加训练。
choice_prompt:7:1122218005.male: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
choice_prompt:7:1122218005.female: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.

say:8:1122218007:1.text: I'll come up with a plan based on your intel. Once those two have recovered, we'll proceed to the next step.
say:8:1122218007:1.source_cn: 之后我会根据你的情报，进行下一步计划。等他们养好了伤，...
say:8:1122218007:1.male: I'll come up with a plan based on your intel. Once those two have recovered, we'll proceed to the next step.
say:8:1122218007:1.female: I'll come up with a plan based on your intel. Once those two have recovered, we'll proceed to the next step.

say:9:1122218008:1.text: But for now, why don't you go rest for a bit?
say:9:1122218008:1.source_cn: 在那之前，你也好好休息一阵子吧。
say:9:1122218008:1.male: But for now, why don't you go rest for a bit?
say:9:1122218008:1.female: But for now, why don't you go rest for a bit?

say:11:1122218006:1.text: Hah, don't let the other two hear you say that!
say:11:1122218006:1.source_cn: 哈，这话可别让他们听见。
say:11:1122218006:1.male: Hah, don't let the other two hear you say that!
say:11:1122218006:1.female: Hah, don't let the other two hear you say that!
